summary: Draft collinear AFM NiO PBE+U plan: SCF, bands, then DOS, preserving the input cell and site order.
notes: All 32 supplied moments are preserved in original site order. No relaxation, SOC, hybrid functional or oxygen +U; preserve the entire input structure.
Dudarev U_eff = U - J = 4.5 eV for Ni. NELM=120 uses the supplied default; inactive relaxation settings remain null.
Bands and DOS use their SCF prerequisites and consistent PBE+U settings; DOS uses the mesh, not the band path (https://www.vasp.at/wiki/index.php/ICHARG).

AFM moments specify an initial ordering, not an established ground state (https://www.vasp.at/wiki/index.php/MAGMOM). Past runs use different structures and settings and do not validate this plan's convergence.
